patch_description: Crossover combining the two best-performing variants. The current program's per-item vectorized LPT loop in `balanced_packing` (times_algorithm 0.01) is replaced with the snake/boustrophedon round-robin packing from the fastest variant (times_algorithm 0.00), which is fully vectorized with a single sort and scatter — no Python loop over groups. This keeps the identical hierarchical structure (group packing, per-node replication, GPU packing) and the same water-filling `replicate_experts`, preserving the same outputs while cutting algorithm runtime. All scatter/gather machinery and the final `log2phy` construction are unchanged to guarantee identical interfaces.
